confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Penang price levels; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and hawker anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain and assume typical July rates including taxes and fees. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value came from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page, not from opening the RBA F11 table directly, so verify it against the official table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Southeast Asian tourist hubs with similar hawker, guesthouse, and mid-range restaurant price levels, adjusted to Malaysian ringgit pricing (about RM 4.3 per USD). Accommodation anchors reflect George Town's historic-district area where visitors typically stay.
